news_items.title: U.S. officials discuss potential Venezuela energy investment framework
news_items.snippet: U.S. officials are exploring potential investment and security arrangements tied to Venezuela's oil sector, according to sources familiar with the matter.
news_items.content_excerpt: The Biden administration is reportedly in discussions about a framework that would allow American companies to invest in Venezuela's struggling oil industry. The move comes amid efforts to stabilize global energy markets and reduce reliance on Russian oil imports.

news_items.title: Gold jumps as investors seek hedges amid geopolitical uncertainty
news_items.snippet: Gold prices surged as investors sought safe-haven assets amid rising geopolitical tensions and mixed economic signals.
news_items.content_excerpt: Spot gold climbed 1.2% to $2,045.30 an ounce as traders positioned for potential volatility. The move suggests investors are adopting a 'risk-on with protection' stance rather than pure risk appetite.

news_items.title: Chip gains offset software weakness as market leadership rotates
news_items.snippet: Semiconductor stocks led tech higher while software names lagged, pointing to a more selective market environment.
news_items.content_excerpt: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 1.8% as AI-related chipmakers extended their rally. Meanwhile, high-multiple software stocks faced pressure as investors rotated toward companies with stronger near-term cash flow visibility.
